# Virtuous Living Real Estate

## About
Virtuous Living Real Estate is a Klerksdorp-based estate agency founded by Sean Jordaan. We specialise in residential property sales, property consultations, and investment solutions across the North West Province. Our approach is built on integrity, transparency, and genuine client relationships.

## Services
- Property Consultation (free initial consultation)
- Residential Sales
- Property Listings & Marketing
- Client Support & After-Sales Service
- Investment Solutions

## Location
Based in Klerksdorp, North West Province, South Africa. We serve Klerksdorp, Stilfontein, Orkney, Potchefstroom, and surrounding areas in the North West Province.

## Service Boundaries
Serving Klerksdorp, Stilfontein, Orkney, Potchefstroom, and the broader North West Province. Available for consultations at our Klerksdorp office or at your property.
